NONE: › a period of peace that has been forced on a large area, such as an empire or even the whole world, by the most powerful nation of that time
強權統制的和平（在一個廣大區域，如一個帝國乃至整個世界，由當時最強大的國家強制實行的一段和平時期）

example: Pax Romana (= the peace forced by Rome on its empire)
羅馬帝國統治下的太平
The vice president promised that there would be no attempt to impose a Pax Americana on the region.
副總統承諾不會企圖在該地區實行「美國強權統制的和平」。
